name: signupgenius-mcp
description: SignUpGenius MCP — read sign-ups, slots and groups, RSVP, and claim or release slots. Three auth paths: Pro API key, email/password, or sign in via the fetchproxy browser extension.

signupgenius_email.title: Email (session mode)
signupgenius_email.description: SignUpGenius login email. Pair with the password below to enable session mode — works on free accounts and supports every tool except slot reports. Direct email/password accounts only (no Google/Apple/Facebook/Microsoft SSO, no 2FA). Leave blank to use the fetchproxy browser extension instead.

signupgenius_password.title: Password (session mode)
signupgenius_password.description: SignUpGenius password. Required only when the email above is set. Stored locally in the bundle config — keep it private.

signupgenius_user_key.title: Pro API key (key mode)
signupgenius_user_key.description: SignUpGenius API key from Pro Tools > API Management. Required ONLY for the slot REPORT tools (filled/available/all participants) — those need a Pro subscription. If both this and email/password are set, the key wins.

tools.name: signupgenius_list_groups
tools.description: List groups created by the user

tools.name: signupgenius_get_group_member
tools.description: Get detailed info for a group member

tools.name: signupgenius_add_group_member
tools.description: Add a member to a group (write)

tools.name: signupgenius_list_created_active
tools.description: List active sign-ups created by the user

tools.name: signupgenius_list_created_expired
tools.description: List expired sign-ups created by the user

tools.name: signupgenius_list_created_all
tools.description: List all sign-ups created by the user

tools.name: signupgenius_list_invited
tools.description: List sign-ups the user was invited to

tools.name: signupgenius_list_signedupfor
tools.description: List sign-ups the user has signed up for

tools.name: signupgenius_legacy_get_my_signups
tools.description: List the user's sign-ups via the legacy wizard API (session mode)

tools.name: signupgenius_report_all
tools.description: Full slot report for a sign-up (Pro key, owner-scoped)

tools.name: signupgenius_report_filled
tools.description: Filled-slot report for a sign-up (Pro key, owner-scoped)

tools.name: signupgenius_report_available
tools.description: Available-slot report for a sign-up (Pro key, owner-scoped)

tools.name: signupgenius_get_public_signup
tools.description: Look up any public sign-up's metadata by URL — no auth required

tools.name: signupgenius_list_slots
tools.description: List slots, availability and participants on any public sign-up — no auth required

tools.name: signupgenius_rsvp
tools.description: RSVP yes/no/maybe to a headcount sign-up (write, confirm first)

tools.name: signupgenius_claim_slot
tools.description: Claim a slot on a slot-based sign-up (write, requires confirm:true)

tools.name: signupgenius_release_slot
tools.description: Withdraw a slot the user signed up for (write, requires confirm:true)
